REPLACE:central_secretariat_bureaucracy = {
	implementation_price = price:implement_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price = price:maintain_bureaucracy_price
	removal_price = price:remove_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price_modifier = {
		value = country_economical_base
		multiply = 0.004
		if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } # OEBYZ switch: no upkeep when bureaucracy is off
	}

	potential = {
		oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes # OEBYZ switch
		has_or_had_tag = CHI
	}

	estates_that_like = {
		crown_estate
		burghers_estate
	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		nobles_estate
	}

	#neutral
	neutral_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		government_size = 1
	}

	#positive - zhongshu_sheng advance raises scale by 50%
	positive_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		scale = {
			value = {
				add = scope:maintenance
				desc = "[bureaucracy_maintenance|e]"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { root ?= { has_advance = zhongshu_sheng } }
				multiply = {
					desc = "[ShowAdvanceName('zhongshu_sheng')]"
					value = 1.5
				}
			}
		}
		monthly_legitimacy = 0.2
		monthly_celestial_authority = 0.02
	}

	#negative - administrative chaos from an underfunded secretariat raises the cost of political decisions
	negative_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		scale = {
			value = {
				add = 1
				desc = script_value_base
			}
			subtract = {
				value = scope:maintenance
				desc = "[bureaucracy_maintenance|e]"
				format = "TWO_DP_ENTRY_FORMAT_PERCENT_NEG"
			}
		}
		stability_cost_efficiency = -0.1
		monthly_celestial_authority = -0.04
	}
	implementation_price_modifier = { value = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } } # OEBYZ switch
	removal_price_modifier = { value = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } } # OEBYZ switch
}

				limit = { root ?= { has_reform = government_reform:three_departments_system } }

				}

				}

REPLACE:imperial_senate_bureaucracy = {
	implementation_price = price:implement_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price = price:maintain_bureaucracy_price
	removal_price = price:remove_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price_modifier = {
		value = country_economical_base
		multiply = 0.003
		if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } # OEBYZ switch: no upkeep when bureaucracy is off
	}

	potential = {
		oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes # OEBYZ switch
		has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix"
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			AND = {
				has_or_had_tag = TRE
				has_variable = tre_unlocked_byz_bureaucracies
			}
		}
	}

	estates_that_like = {
		nobles_estate
	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		crown_estate
	}

	#neutral
	neutral_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		parliament_duration_modifier = 0.3
	}

	#positive
	positive_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		scale = {
			value = {
				add = scope:maintenance
				desc = "[bureaucracy_maintenance|e]"
			}
		}
		parliament_base_support = 0.075
	}

	#negative
	negative_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		scale = {
			value = {
				add = 1
				desc = script_value_base
			}
			subtract = {
				value = scope:maintenance
				desc = "[bureaucracy_maintenance|e]"
				format = "TWO_DP_ENTRY_FORMAT_PERCENT_NEG"
			}
		}
		monthly_legitimacy = -0.2
		monthly_republican_tradition = -0.2
	}
	implementation_price_modifier = { value = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } } # OEBYZ switch
	removal_price_modifier = { value = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } } # OEBYZ switch
}

REPLACE:kephalai_bureaucracy = {
	implementation_price = price:implement_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price = price:maintain_bureaucracy_price
	removal_price = price:remove_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price_modifier = {
		value = country_economical_base
		multiply = 0.003
		if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } # OEBYZ switch: no upkeep when bureaucracy is off
	}

	potential = {
		oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes # OEBYZ switch
		has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix"
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			AND = {
				has_or_had_tag = TRE
				has_variable = tre_unlocked_byz_bureaucracies
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = won_fate_of_the_phoenix_disaster_tt
				has_variable = won_fate_of_the_phoenix_disaster_variable
			}

			AND = {
				has_or_had_tag = TRE
				owns = location:constantinople
			}
		}
	}

	estates_that_like = {
		crown_estate
		burghers_estate
	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		nobles_estate
	}

	#neutral
	neutral_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		government_size = 1
	}

	#positive
	positive_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		scale = {
			value = {
				add = scope:maintenance
				desc = "[bureaucracy_maintenance|e]"
			}
		}
		num_local_governors = 1
	}

	#negative
	negative_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		scale = {
			value = {
				add = 1
				desc = script_value_base
			}
			subtract = {
				value = scope:maintenance
				desc = "[bureaucracy_maintenance|e]"
				format = "TWO_DP_ENTRY_FORMAT_PERCENT_NEG"
			}
		}
		estate_enrichment = 0.3
		global_non_rural_monthly_prosperity = -0.003
	}
	implementation_price_modifier = { value = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } } # OEBYZ switch
	removal_price_modifier = { value = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } } # OEBYZ switch
}

REPLACE:magister_militum_bureaucracy = {
	implementation_price = price:implement_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price = price:maintain_bureaucracy_price
	removal_price = price:remove_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price_modifier = {
		value = country_economical_base
		multiply = 0.003
		if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } # OEBYZ switch: no upkeep when bureaucracy is off
	}

	potential = {
		oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes # OEBYZ switch
		has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix"
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			AND = {
				has_or_had_tag = TRE
				has_variable = tre_unlocked_byz_bureaucracies
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = has_unlocked_bureaucracy_via_flavor_byz_31_tt
			has_reform = government_reform:modern_imperial_army
		}
	}

	estates_that_like = {
		crown_estate
		burghers_estate
	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		nobles_estate
	}

	#neutral
	neutral_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		monthly_army_tradition = 0.2
		monthly_navy_tradition = 0.2
	}

	#positive
	positive_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		scale = {
			value = {
				add = scope:maintenance
				desc = "[bureaucracy_maintenance|e]"
			}
		}

		train_general_ability = 25
		train_admiral_ability = 25
		military_tactics = 0.2
	}

	#negative
	negative_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		scale = {
			value = {
				add = 1
				desc = script_value_base
			}
			subtract = {
				value = scope:maintenance
				desc = "[bureaucracy_maintenance|e]"
				format = "TWO_DP_ENTRY_FORMAT_PERCENT_NEG"
			}
		}
		monthly_legitimacy = -0.2
		global_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}
	implementation_price_modifier = { value = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } } # OEBYZ switch
	removal_price_modifier = { value = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } } # OEBYZ switch
}

REPLACE:themata_bureaucracy = {
	implementation_price = price:implement_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price = price:maintain_bureaucracy_price
	removal_price = price:remove_bureaucracy_price
	maintenance_price_modifier = {
		value = country_economical_base
		multiply = 0.003
		if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } # OEBYZ switch: no upkeep when bureaucracy is off
	}

	potential = {
		oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes # OEBYZ switch
		has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix"
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = TRE
		}
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				any_current_bureaucracy = {
					bureaucracy_type = bureaucracy_type:magister_militum_bureaucracy
				}
			}
			has_reform = government_reform:theme_system
		}
	}

	estates_that_like = {
		nobles_estate
	}
	estates_that_dislike = {
		burghers_estate
	}

	#neutral
	neutral_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		global_manpower_modifier = 0.075
		global_levy_size_modifier = 0.075
		monthly_army_tradition = 0.1
	}

	#positive
	positive_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		scale = {
			value = {
				add = scope:maintenance
				desc = "[bureaucracy_maintenance|e]"
			}
		}
		global_defensive = 0.2
	}

	#negative
	negative_modifier = {
		potential_trigger = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } # OEBYZ switch
		scale = {
			value = {
				add = 1
				desc = script_value_base
			}
			subtract = {
				value = scope:maintenance
				desc = "[bureaucracy_maintenance|e]"
				format = "TWO_DP_ENTRY_FORMAT_PERCENT_NEG"
			}
		}
		levy_recovery_modifier = -0.2
		global_nobles_estate_power = 0.5
	}
	implementation_price_modifier = { value = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } } # OEBYZ switch
	removal_price_modifier = { value = 1 if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_settings_bureaucracy_enabled = yes } } value = 0 } } # OEBYZ switch
}
